clips.title: The story
paras: In eastern Raven Hill, The Night Watch calls on outsiders to enter the crypts. Commander Althea Ebonlocke sends them to destroy the plague spreaders while her guards defend Darkshire. This is the final mission in the town guard’s direct campaign against the undead overrun.

Darkshire stands nearly alone, abandoned by Stormwind’s military and reliant on its civilian militia, The Night Watch. Commander Althea Ebonlocke has spent her limited manpower guarding the crossroads, town perimeter, and supply lines. As the restless dead multiply across Duskwood, she turns to wandering champions to carry the fight into Raven Hill’s shadowed depths.

The eastern mausoleum in Raven Hill Cemetery holds one of the region’s most dangerous concentrations of undead, unlike the open barrows. Its stone crypt teems with plague spreaders, ghouls whose afflictions can sicken the living. Destroying twenty gives The Night Watch room to breathe and helps keep Darkshire from facing a coordinated undead surge from the west.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The situation in Raven Hill is still grim. The safety of Darkshire is in your hands, friend. I don't have enough Watchers to keep the town safe. We need you to dispatch for Raven Hill yet again and rid the eastern mausoleum of 20 Plague Spreaders!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I need your assistance, friend. Travel to the cemetery to the northwest and rid the eastern mausoleum of 20 Plague Spreaders.
Return to me when your task is complete.

clips.title: Completion
paras: On behalf of the people of Darkshire and as the Leader of the Night Watch, I thank you, friend, for your bravery and dedication. May the Light shine upon your ways.
